text:
mia: Heads up 1: proposal to change default auth log retention from 365d -> 90d to reduce storage + limit scoped exposure. Need feedback on RBAC, SIEM export behavior, and KMS unwrap.
drew: 90d seems reasonable for most internal accounts but add an exemption for regulated customers.
nora: Agree. Also need a strong audit trail for any KMS unwraps.
mia: Thinking: snapshots for triage (timeboxed), legal-hold copy path (7y), and a KMS-proxy that mints ephemeral unwrap tokens (ttl short).
sam: RBAC: add `snapshot_requester` and `snapshot_viewer` roles. All grants must be time-limited and require an approver.
infra-bot: RFC created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/900 :paperclip:
drew: SIEM exports: require CMK-wrapped copies + ticket id. Export metadata logged for 1y.
nora: Audit stream `kms_unwrap_events` should be immutable and kept 2y+. Include principal, approver, request_id, ip, query fingerprint.
mia: I'll update the RFC with roles, unwrap proxy sketch, lifecycle rules, and legal-hold flow. Scheduling a quick review tomorrow.
